description: This file implements the RemoteKeymaster class, which acts as a client interface to communicate with a remote keymaster service via a channel. It includes methods for sending commands, initializing the connection, and handling various keymaster operations such as key generation, attestation, and configuration. The code manages message serialization/deserialization, system property retrieval, and logging of errors.

classes.name: RemoteKeymaster
classes.description: A class that facilitates communication with a remote keymaster service, providing methods for various cryptographic and configuration operations.

methods.name: ForwardCommand
methods.description: Sends a command request to the remote keymaster channel and processes the response, handling errors and deserialization.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Performs initial configuration of the remote keymaster, including setting system properties, boot levels, verified boot info, and attestation IDs.

methods.name: GetVersion
methods.description: Requests the version information from the remote keymaster.

methods.name: AddRngEntropy
methods.description: Adds entropy to the random number generator.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the keymaster with specific parameters.

methods.name: GenerateKey
methods.description: Generates a new cryptographic key, adding creation date if necessary.

methods.name: GenerateCsrV2
methods.description: Generates a version 2 certificate signing request.

methods.name: GetKeyCharacteristics
methods.description: Retrieves characteristics of a specified key.

methods.name: ImportKey
methods.description: Imports a key into the keymaster.

methods.name: UpgradeKey
methods.description: Upgrades a key to a new format or version.

methods.name: EarlyBootEnded
methods.description: Indicates that early boot has ended.
